mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Federal Funds Rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Federal Funds Rate does not decline consistently over a 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 6.5% triggers a strong labor market recovery, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing below 6.5%, or the effect dissipates within less than 3 days in 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic expansion, enhancing corporate profitability and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the correlation between GDPC1 and INDPRO is below 0.7 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in the Federal Funds Rate above 4% signals higher interest rates, compressing equity discount rates and reducing future cash flow valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4% in a tightening regime, or the rate does not rise consistently over a 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A convergence of falling unemployment (UNRATE) and rising job growth (PAYEMS) above 1.2M creates a strong labor market recovery, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative despite meeting the trigger condition, or the effect dissipates within less than 3 days in 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in industrial production (INDPRO) above 98.5 signals unexpected strength in supply chains, accelerating corporate production and export activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the increase in INDPRO is not sustained beyond the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeding 3% annually indicates robust economic momentum, lifting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the GDP growth trend reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained increase in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 13,500 signals approaching peak demand, prompting market anticipation of near-term rate hikes and short-term equity gains over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite GDPC1 exceeding 13,500 in the late-cycle regime, or the growth rate does not persist for 3 consecutive months.
